sentences.text: The Home Loan Agreement copy includes a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure.
For this case, the current applicable RBI rule for a Tier 3 UCB and a floating-rate, non-business individual loan sanctioned on 2026-02-10 says pre-payment charges are not permitted.
So the 3% pre-payment fee in the copy does not comply with RBI’s current rules, and the earlier RBI pre-payment-charge directions are no longer in force.
